start.title: Start your website — %s
start.heading: Your idea deserves a place on the web.
start.lead: Choose a starter theme, create your account, and sign in to the customer area. Site operators continue to use the admin sign-in.
start.proof: Starter themes included · No payment card
start.step1.title: Make it yours
start.step1.body: Choose a ship-with theme and your account details.
start.step2.title: Create your account
start.step2.body: Use an email you can access. You can sign in right away.
start.step3.title: Open your account
start.step3.body: Continue in the customer area, or ask an operator for admin access.
start.theme_intro: Three GoRun identity themes (Modern, Minimal, Serif). You can change appearance later from the admin.
start.theme.business.label: Modern · Clean / technical
start.theme.business.title: Put your work forward.
start.theme.business.desc: Introduce your organization, present services and receive enquiries.
start.theme.portfolio.label: Minimal · Quiet / local
start.theme.portfolio.title: Let your work speak.
start.theme.portfolio.desc: Your introduction, selected projects and a clear way to reach you.
start.theme.magazine.label: Serif · Type-led reading
start.theme.magazine.title: A home for your stories.
start.theme.magazine.desc: Publish articles, organize categories and build your own publication.
start.account_intro: Creates a customer account on this site (not the admin console).
start.name: Your name
start.submit_body: After creating an account you can sign in at /start/login. Staff use /admin/login.
login.title: Sign in — %s
login.heading: Sign in to your account
login.lead: Customer accounts use this page. Site operators use the admin sign-in.
login.staff_only: Staff accounts sign in at the admin console.
verify.title: Verify email — %s
verify.heading: Your account is ready.
verify.lead: Sign in with the password you chose. If an operator mailed an activation link, you can open it from your inbox.
error.name: Enter your name.
error.password: Password must be at least 10 characters.
error.taken: That email is already registered. Sign in instead.
